items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 32th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 74 while the rest average 39 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 74/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: -79% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 26,848 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,327 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: -79% below its long-run trend (BUY! band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.3; price sits -79% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-15.5% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.96M SPX. 4w -13.3% · 12w -15.5% · 26w -22.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-15.5% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: 1 new proven top-timer in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 1 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: Diamond tier grew 1.0pp in ~14d → 89.9% of supply
items.detail: Supply in the longest-held tier rose 88.8%→89.9% over ~14 days — a cohort maturing into diamond.
items.framing: Float tightening as coins age into the strongest-held tier.
items.note: HELD, not BOUGHT — diamond grows by aging; frame it as maturing/held.

items.headline: -1.1σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1.1σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1.1σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: 7.43M SPX moved onto exchanges in 7 days
items.detail: Net exchange balance change is 1.2σ from its trailing norm — an acceleration of deposits (sell-side supply building).
items.framing: Deposits to exchanges are accelerating — 7.43M SPX in a week, well above the usual. Frame as sell-side supply building, a position read, not a top call.
items.checkable: Net exchange balance from the tagged CEX wallets, over the public transfer history.

items.headline: NUPL -0.03 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.03 (from MVRV 0.97) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.97 = 12th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.97 sits at the 12th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 12th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: SOPR 0.976 — coins moving at a loss

items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.
